title: Cornell police made drug arrest at Chi Phi 22 hours before alleged gang rape, log shows
summary: The Cornell University Police Department made a drug arrest at the Chi Phi fraternity house less than a day before the alleged 2024 gang rape of Jane Doe, daily crime logs show. Meanwhile, the school's president, Michael Kotlikoff, released a video statement calling the case "deeply disturbing." Lilia Luciano reports.
